summary: Enhance your IT service management skills with our comprehensive ITIL Framework Training. Gain expertise in ITSM practices for efficient operations.
lede: IT service management training helps professionals in service delivery, support, operations and governance organize and improve technology-enabled services. The practical work includes designing incident and request workflows, investigating recurring problems, assessing change risks, and mapping configuration relationships. Participants also calculate service-level measures, structure performance reports, and prepare prioritized improvement actions using service data and digital templates.
audienceIntro: IT service management training suits professionals who contribute to technology service delivery, control, support, governance, or improvement. It supports foundation to intermediate development and welcomes professionals who work with service management processes without requiring prior ITIL certification.
prerequisites: You need basic exposure to technology services or support operations. You do not need coding or programming skills, and the exercises use provided ITSM datasets, templates, and scenario records rather than production systems. Advanced concepts such as AI-assisted ticket classification, automated CMDB updates, DevOps release coordination, and service analytics receive conceptual or operational coverage, not technical engineering instruction.
